# agentmemory MCP tools reference

Generated from `src/mcp/tools-registry.ts`. Do not edit the block below by hand; run `npm run skills:gen` after changing the registry.

<!-- AUTOGEN:tools START - generated by scripts/skills/generate.ts, do not edit by hand -->
agentmemory exposes 74 MCP tools. 8 are in the lean core set (`--tools core` or `AGENTMEMORY_TOOLS=core`); the rest load with `--tools all` (default).

| Tool | Core | Parameters | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `memory_action_create` |  | `title`*: string, `description`: string, `priority`: number, `project`: string, `tags`: string, `parentId`: string, `requires`: string | Use to create an actionable work item with typed dependencies, call to break down a task into tracked steps that can be leased, updated, and completed. |
| `memory_action_update` |  | `actionId`*: string, `status`: string, `result`: string, `priority`: number | Use to update an action's status, priority, or details, call to mark progress on tracked work items. Set status to 'done' to complete it and unblock dependent actions. |
| `memory_artifact_get` |  | `id`*: string, `project`: string, `agentId`: string | Use to fetch one artifact record by ID within its project and agent scope. |
| `memory_artifact_save` |  | `name`*: string, `kind`: string, `path`: string, `uri`: string, `digest`: string, `provenance`*: object, `project`: string, `agentId`: string, `idempotencyKey`: string | Use to persist an artifact reference with its path or URI, digest, media type, linked evidence, experiment IDs, and provenance. |
| `memory_artifact_search` |  | `query`*: string, `kind`: string, `project`: string, `agentId`: string, `limit`: number | Use to search artifacts by name, path, URI, digest, description, linked evidence, or linked experiment. |
| `memory_audit` |  | `operation`: string, `limit`: number | Use to view the audit trail of memory operations, call to see who changed what and when, or debug unexpected modifications. |
| `memory_checkpoint` |  | `operation`*: string, `name`: string, `checkpointId`: string, `status`: string, `type`: string, `linkedActionIds`: string | Use to gate action progress on external conditions (CI result, approval, deploy status), call to create or resolve checkpoints. For multi-agent or CI-integrated setups. |
| `memory_claude_bridge_sync` |  | `direction`*: string | Use to sync memory between agentmemory and Claude Code, call when switching between them to keep both stores consistent. |
| `memory_commit_lookup` |  | `sha`*: string | Use to look up the agent session that produced a git commit, call to trace a code change back to the conversation that created it. Returns commit metadata and linked sessions. |
| `memory_commits` |  | `branch`: string, `repo`: string, `limit`: number | Use to list recent commits linked to agent sessions, call to review what was built recently or find commits from a specific effort. Optionally filtered by branch or repo. |
| `memory_compress_file` |  | `filePath`*: string | Use to reduce the token footprint of a markdown file while preserving headings, URLs, and code blocks. Creates a .original.md backup before writing. |
| `memory_conflict_resolve` |  | `conflictId`*: string, `status`*: string, `winnerMemoryId`: string, `reason`: string, `memoryStates`: object | Use to resolve a durable contradiction record with an explicit status, supporting reason, winner or per-memory epistemic states, without deleting either side's evidence. |
| `memory_consolidate` | yes | `tier`: string | Use to transform accumulated observations into structured long-term memories (episodic → semantic → procedural). Run periodically to organize observations into higher-quality memories that survive sessions. |
| `memory_crystallize` |  | `actionIds`*: string, `project`: string, `sessionId`: string | Use to compress a completed action chain into a concise summary, call after finishing a multi-step task to distill what happened (narrative, key outcomes, files affected, lessons). |
| `memory_diagnose` | yes | `categories`: string | Use to run health checks across all subsystems (actions, leases, sentinels, sketches, signals, sessions, memories, mesh), call to find stuck, orphaned, or inconsistent state. Follow with memory_heal to fix issues. |
| `memory_evidence_get` |  | `id`*: string, `project`: string, `agentId`: string | Use to fetch one typed evidence record by ID within its project and agent scope. |
| `memory_evidence_save` |  | `kind`*: string, `content`: string, `claim`: string, `locator`: string, `provenance`*: object, `project`: string, `agentId`: string, `artifactId`: string, `experimentId`: string, `idempotencyKey`: string | Use to persist typed, attributable evidence such as a file range, log excerpt, commit, URL, tool output, or verification result. Provenance with channel and capturedAt is required. |
| `memory_evidence_search` |  | `query`*: string, `kind`: string, `project`: string, `agentId`: string, `limit`: number | Use to search typed evidence by content, claim, locator, source, artifact, or experiment within an optional project and agent scope. |
| `memory_evidence_verify` |  | `id`*: string, `verifier`*: string, `verificationMethod`*: string, `result`: object, `project`: string, `agentId`: string | Use to persist how and when a verifier checked an evidence record, including the verification method and optional result. |
| `memory_experiment_create` |  | `objective`*: string, `hypothesis`: string, `environment`: string, `sourceRevision`: string, `commands`: array, `artifactIds`: array, `evidenceIds`: array, `observationIds`: array, `actionIds`: array, `sessionIds`: array, `graphNodeIds`: array, `negativeMemoryIds`: array, `provenance`*: object, `authority`: object, `project`: string, `agentId`: string, `idempotencyKey`: string | Use to create a first-class experiment with an objective, hypothesis, environment, revision, toolchain, commands, linked records, and provenance. |
| `memory_experiment_expand` |  | `id`*: string, `project`: string, `agentId`: string | Use to fetch an experiment together with its linked actions, sessions, observations, artifacts, evidence, graph nodes, and negative memories. |
| `memory_experiment_get` |  | `id`*: string, `project`: string, `agentId`: string | Use to fetch a first-class experiment by ID within its project and agent scope. |
| `memory_experiment_list` |  | `status`: string, `project`: string, `agentId`: string, `limit`: number | Use to list first-class experiments by status and optional project or agent scope. |
| `memory_experiment_search` |  | `query`*: string, `status`: string, `project`: string, `agentId`: string, `limit`: number | Use to search first-class experiments by objective, hypothesis, command, environment, result, conclusion, or linked records. |
| `memory_experiment_update` |  | `id`*: string, `status`: string, `result`: object, `conclusion`: string, `artifactIds`: array, `evidenceIds`: array, `observationIds`: array, `actionIds`: array, `sessionIds`: array, `graphNodeIds`: array, `negativeMemoryIds`: array, `authority`: object, `project`: string, `agentId`: string | Use to update an experiment with its state, observations, artifacts, evidence, result, conclusion, or follow-up links. |
| `memory_export` |  | none | Use to export all memory data as JSON, for backup, migration to another system, or offline analysis. |
| `memory_facet_query` |  | `matchAll`: string, `matchAny`: string, `targetType`: string | Use to find items by facet tags with AND/OR logic, call after tagging items to locate all items matching specific criteria (e.g. priority:urgent AND team:backend). |
| `memory_facet_tag` |  | `targetId`*: string, `targetType`*: string, `dimension`*: string, `value`*: string | Use to attach structured tags (dimension:value) to items, call to label by priority, team, or status for later querying with memory_facet_query. |
| `memory_file_history` |  | `files`*: string, `sessionId`: string | Use to get past observations about specific files, call before editing a file to understand its history and past decisions, or when investigating how a file was created or modified. |
| `memory_frontier` |  | `project`: string, `agentId`: string, `limit`: number | Use to see all unblocked actions ranked by priority, call when you have multiple pending tasks to decide what to work on next. For a single recommendation, use memory_next instead. |
| `memory_governance_delete` |  | `memoryIds`*: string, `reason`: string | Use to delete specific memories with an audit trail, call to remove incorrect, outdated, or sensitive memories while preserving a deletion record. |
| `memory_graph_query` |  | `startNodeId`: string, `nodeType`: string, `maxDepth`: number, `query`: string | Use to query the knowledge graph for entities and relationships, call to explore connected concepts or discover unexpected relationships between items. |
| `memory_heal` |  | `categories`: string, `dryRun`: string | Use to auto-fix issues found by memory_diagnose, unblocks stuck actions, expires stale leases, cleans up orphaned data. Pass dryRun=true to preview without changing. |
| `memory_insight_list` |  | `project`: string, `minConfidence`: number, `limit`: number | Use to list synthesized insights, call to review what the system has learned about your projects. Higher-order observations derived from patterns across memories, lessons, and crystals. |
| `memory_lease` |  | `actionId`*: string, `agentId`*: string, `operation`*: string, `result`: string, `ttlMs`: number | Use to claim exclusive ownership of an action, prevents duplicate work across agents. For multi-agent setups. |
| `memory_lesson_delete` |  | `lessonId`*: string | Use to soft-delete a lesson by id. Deleted lessons are excluded from recall and list; re-saving the same content creates a fresh lesson. |
| `memory_lesson_recall` |  | `query`*: string, `project`: string, `minConfidence`: number, `limit`: number | Use to search saved lessons, call before starting a task similar to one done before. Returns lessons sorted by confidence and recency. |
| `memory_lesson_save` | yes | `content`*: string, `context`: string, `confidence`: number, `project`: string, `tags`: string | Use to save a lesson learned, call after discovering a reliable pattern ('X works for Y situation', 'avoid Z because...'). Confidence strengthens on reinforcement, decays when unused. |
| `memory_mesh_sync` |  | `peerId`: string, `direction`: string | Use to sync memories and actions with peer agentmemory instances, call to keep memory consistent across separate agent environments. For multi-agent setups. |
| `memory_negative_memory_lookup` |  | `query`*: string, `environment`: string, `sourceRevision`: string, `asOf`: string, `project`: string, `agentId`: string, `limit`: number | Use to check reusable do-not-retry knowledge before repeating an approach, scoped by project, agent, environment, revision, and historical validity. |
| `memory_negative_memory_save` |  | `approach`*: string, `reason`*: string, `environment`: string, `sourceRevision`: string, `provenance`*: object, `project`: string, `agentId`: string, `idempotencyKey`: string | Use to record a known-invalid, failed, or disproven approach with its reason, evidence, experiment links, environment, revision, validity interval, and provenance. |
| `memory_next` |  | `project`: string, `agentId`: string | Use to get the single most important next action, call for a quick recommendation instead of scanning the full list. To see all available actions, use memory_frontier. |
| `memory_obsidian_export` |  | `vaultDir`: string, `types`: string | Use to export memories as Obsidian-compatible Markdown, for manual review, sharing with humans, or archiving in a personal note-taking system. Includes YAML frontmatter and wikilinks. |
| `memory_patterns` |  | `project`: string | Use to detect recurring patterns across sessions, call when reviewing a project to find repeated bugs, recurring workflows, or common pitfalls worth formalizing as lessons. |
| `memory_profile` |  | `project`*: string, `refresh`: string | Use to get a project's top concepts and file patterns, call when starting work in an unfamiliar project to quickly understand its structure and common terminology. |
| `memory_recall` | yes | `query`*: string, `limit`: number, `format`: string, `token_budget`: number, `project`: string, `agentId`: string | Use when you need focused details from previous sessions, past decisions, or earlier file changes. Prefer compact format or a small token_budget first, then request fuller results only when needed. |
| `memory_reflect` | yes | `project`: string, `maxClusters`: number | Use to synthesize higher-order insights from accumulated memories, call periodically to discover emergent patterns, cross-project themes, or new best practices you would not have spotted manually. |
| `memory_relations` |  | `memoryId`*: string, `maxHops`: number, `minConfidence`: number | Use to explore how memories are connected, call to find all items related to a concept, or trace a topic through the knowledge graph. |
| `memory_retrieval_expand` |  | `handle`*: string, `project`: string, `agentId`: string, `tokenBudget`: number | Use to progressively disclose the full content behind an opaque handle returned by memory_retrieval_plan. The identical project and agent scope is required and handles expire quickly. |
| `memory_retrieval_plan` |  | `query`*: string, `project`: string, `agentId`: string, `limit`: number, `tokenBudget`: number, `budgets`: object | Use to retrieve task context through a deterministic plan across memory, graph, temporal, experiment, artifact, evidence, and negative-memory sources. Returns a tiered context budget, conflict warnings, source coverage, and opaque expansion handles. |
| `memory_routine_run` |  | `routineId`*: string, `project`: string, `initiatedBy`: string | Use to start a predefined multi-step process (e.g. release checklist, deploy pipeline), instantiates a frozen routine, creating actions for each step with proper dependencies. |
| `memory_save` | yes | `content`*: string, `type`: string, `concepts`: string, `files`: string, `project`: string, `agentId`: string, `layer`: string, `epistemicState`: string, `temporal`: object, `authority`: object, `evidenceIds`: array, `artifactIds`: array, `experimentIds`: array | Use to persist an important insight, decision, or pattern to long-term memory, call this when you discover a pattern, confirm a preference, fix a recurring bug, or make a decision worth remembering across sessions. |
| `memory_sentinel_create` |  | `name`*: string, `type`*: string, `config`: string, `linkedActionIds`: string, `expiresInMs`: number | Use to set up an event-driven sentinel that auto-unblocks actions when conditions are met (webhook, timer, threshold, pattern, approval). For multi-agent or event-driven setups. |
| `memory_sentinel_trigger` |  | `sentinelId`*: string, `result`: string | Use to fire a sentinel from an external source, unblocks any gated actions. For multi-agent or CI-integrated setups. |
| `memory_sessions` | yes | none | Use to list recent sessions with their status and observation counts, call to find what you were working on recently, or to locate a session ID for targeted recall. |
| `memory_signal_read` |  | `agentId`*: string, `unreadOnly`: string, `threadId`: string, `limit`: number | Use to read messages sent to an agent, call at session start to check for pending messages or handoffs from other agents. For multi-agent setups. |
| `memory_signal_send` |  | `from`*: string, `to`: string, `content`*: string, `type`: string, `replyTo`: string | Use to send a message to another agent or broadcast, for handoffs, requests, or alerts. Supports threading, typed messages, and TTL expiration. For multi-agent setups. |
| `memory_sketch_create` |  | `title`*: string, `description`: string, `expiresInMs`: number, `project`: string | Use to create an ephemeral action graph for exploratory planning, auto-expires after TTL, can be promoted to permanent actions or discarded. Ideal for trying task breakdowns before committing. |
| `memory_sketch_promote` |  | `sketchId`*: string, `project`: string | Use to convert an exploratory sketch into permanent actions, call after validating a plan to commit it as actionable work items. |
| `memory_slot_append` |  | `label`*: string, `text`*: string | Use to add text to an existing slot without replacing it, ideal for appending to a running list like 'pending_items'. Fails with 413 if append exceeds sizeLimit (compact via memory_slot_replace first). |
| `memory_slot_create` |  | `label`*: string, `content`: string, `sizeLimit`: number, `description`: string, `pinned`: string, `scope`: string | Use to create a named persistent context slot (e.g. project notes, preferences) that survives across sessions. Rejects if the label already exists. |
| `memory_slot_delete` |  | `label`*: string | Use to delete a slot. Seeded default slots cannot be deleted if marked readOnly. |
| `memory_slot_get` |  | `label`*: string | Use to read a single slot by label, call to check the current value of a slot like 'persona' or 'pending_items'. |
| `memory_slot_list` |  | none | Use to list all memory slots (pinned + project + global), editable, size-limited units that persist across sessions. |
| `memory_slot_replace` |  | `label`*: string, `content`*: string | Use to update a slot's entire content, call when a slot needs a fresh state. Fails if content exceeds sizeLimit. |
| `memory_smart_search` | yes | `query`*: string, `expandIds`: string, `limit`: number, `project`: string, `agentId`: string | Use for broad exploratory recall when you don't know the exact terms or keyword search returns too little. Hybrid semantic+keyword, returns compact initial matches; expand only the IDs needed for full details. |
| `memory_snapshot_create` |  | `message`: string | Use to create a git-versioned checkpoint of current memory state, call before bulk deletes, consolidations, or imports to create a rollback point. |
| `memory_team_feed` |  | `limit`: number | Use to see what other agents have shared since you last checked. For multi-agent setups. |
| `memory_team_share` |  | `itemId`*: string, `itemType`*: string | Use to broadcast a memory or observation to other agents on the team. For multi-agent setups. |
| `memory_temporal_graph_query` |  | `entityName`*: string, `asOf`: string, `includeHistory`: boolean | Use to inspect time-valid graph assertions for an entity as of a timestamp, including historical edges and their source observations. |
| `memory_temporal_query` |  | `asOf`: string, `from`: string, `to`: string, `includeHistory`: boolean, `project`: string, `agentId`: string | Use to retrieve memory assertions as current, as-of, or range-valid records while retaining historical and superseded versions when requested. |
| `memory_timeline` |  | `anchor`*: string, `project`: string, `before`: number, `after`: number | Use to see observations around an anchor point, call to see what happened before or after a specific date, event, or session. Helpful for tracing how a decision evolved. |
| `memory_verify` |  | `id`*: string | Use to verify a memory by checking its source evidence, call before relying on a past observation to confirm it is well-founded rather than potentially inaccurate. Returns provenance and confidence scores. |
| `memory_vision_search` |  | `queryText`: string, `queryImageRef`: string, `queryImageBase64`: string, `topK`: number, `sessionId`: string | Use to find screenshots by description or locate visually similar images from past sessions. Cross-modal search via CLIP embeddings; requires AGENTMEMORY_IMAGE_EMBEDDINGS=true. |
